correctness.rationale: From g(Y+a-1), coefficient positivity and the leading monomial guarantee the sum of all coefficients other than any specified one >=a; hence every coefficient <=g(a)-a=b-1. Because g(a)=b+(a-1), its base-b digit sum is a. Substitute Y=b: g(g(a)) is carry-free and its digit sum equals g(a). Differences exactly b-1 imply separate fixed cycles and non-injective semiconjugacy; square-progression expansions in RESULT.md each have legal digits and give disjoint residues 4,7 mod9. Recomputed exactly 2880 polynomial/base examples and 200 progression examples. These finite tests corroborate algebra, not infinite validity.
